gaps.need_description: Multiple portfolio companies pay external payment processors for invoicing, subscriptions, and expense management — a need already covered by NovaPay.
EduFlow needs kit delivery for blended learning; HealthCore needs reliable cold-chain delivery for medical supplies — both partially served by CargoZip.
CargoZip, BuildSmart, and HealthCore all need HR and payroll solutions for their field workforces — a gap not currently filled by any portfolio company.
NovaPay, HealthCore, and BuildSmart all face sector-specific regulatory requirements (financial licensing, health data compliance, construction permits) with no shared tooling.
EduFlow, BuildSmart, and CargoZip all lack a structured marketing and demand-generation capability, relying on ad-hoc agency work or founder-led outreach.
